kidney_ureteric_tree_specimen.species: Mus musculus (E12.5 mouse metanephric kidney whole-mount cytokeratin-GFP ureteric bud tree & pErk1/2 immunofluorescence: Panel A wild-type vs Panel B hypomorphic mutant)

governing_equations.section: Menshykau & Iber (2013) Phys. Biol. 10(4):046003 Eqs. (1)-(7) & Short et al. (2014) Dev. Cell 29:188-202
governing_equations.ret_receptor_pde: dR/dt = D_R * laplacian(R) + gamma * (a / (1 + alpha_S * S) - R + R^2 * G * (1 + beta_W * W))
governing_equations.gdnf_ligand_pde: dG/dt = D_G * laplacian(G) + gamma * (rho_G - R^2 * G) + S_bead(x)
governing_equations.wnt11_epithelial_feedback_ode: dW/dt = gamma_W * (R^2 * G / (K_W + R^2 * G) - W)
governing_equations.homogeneous_steady_state: R* = a + rho_G,  G* = rho_G / (a + rho_G)^2,  (R*)^2 * G* = rho_G
governing_equations.schnakenberg_jacobian_entries: f_R = (rho_G - a)/(rho_G + a),  f_G = (rho_G + a)^2,  g_R = -2*rho_G/(rho_G + a),  g_G = -(rho_G + a)^2
governing_equations.turing_instability_criterion: f_R + g_G < 0,  f_R * g_G - f_G * g_R = (rho_G + a)^2 > 0,  d * f_R + g_G > 2 * sqrt(d * (f_R * g_G - f_G * g_R))
governing_equations.critical_wavenumber_formula: k_c^2 = gamma * sqrt((f_R * g_G - f_G * g_R) / (D_R * D_G)) = gamma * (a + rho_G) / sqrt(D_R * D_G)
governing_equations.tip_normal_velocity_formula: v_tip(s) = v_0 * max(0, R(s)^2 * G(s) - C_thresh) / (1 + kappa_bmp4 * B_stalk)
governing_equations.horton_strahler_scaling_laws: R_b = N_{omega} / N_{omega+1} approx 2.08,  R_L = L_{omega+1} / L_{omega} approx 1.38

ampulla_circumferential_mode_regimes.description: Slender ureteric stalk or BMP4-inhibited tip: single apical R^2*G cap drives forward elongation
Wild-type ureteric ampulla: central GDNF depletion splits R^2*G cap into 2 lateral peaks (m=2)
Swollen early E12.5 or Spry1-/- ampulla: circumference exceeds 3*lambda_c, exciting m=3 trifurcation
Spry1-/- Wolffian duct or exogenous GDNF bead: multi-peak supernumerary budding (m>=4)

perturbation_suite.label: Wild-Type Dichotomous Ureteric Tree (Gdnf+/+; Ret+/+; Spry1+/+)
Spry1-/- Ectopic Supernumerary Budding & Trifurcation (Basson et al. 2005)
Exogenous GDNF-Soaked Bead Attraction & Ampulla Swelling (Watanabe & Costantini 2004)
Exogenous BMP4 Stalk-Elongation & Branching Inhibition (Miyazaki et al. 2000)
Gdnf-/- or Ret-/- Renal Agenesis Negative Control (Zero Ureteric Outgrowth)
